user.title: Pick your area
user.description: Use the map to pick the centre of your search area and set a radius. All fuel stations inside the radius will be listed on the next step.

stations.title: Choose stations
stations.description: Select the fuel stations you want to track. Sensors will be created for each selected station and fuel type.

fuel_types.title: Choose fuel types
fuel_types.description: Select which fuel types to track at the chosen stations.

error.no_stations: No fuel stations were found within the chosen radius. Try a larger radius or move the map marker.
error.api_error: Could not fetch station data from the NSW FuelCheck service. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: The NSW Fuel Station integration is already configured. Use its options to change the tracked stations.

init.title: Search area
init.description: Adjust the centre and radius of your search area.

fuel_types.title: Tracked fuel types
fuel_types.description: Select which fuel types to track at the chosen stations.
